name: XyphrosPortal
tagline: Shared workspaces for tasks, to-dos, and notes.
description: Spin up a workspace, invite the people you're working with, and keep everything in one place. XyphrosPortal gives every workspace its own tasks, to-do lists, and notes, so your team always knows what's been done, what's next, and where the context lives — without it getting scattered across chats and documents.
